summary: ACCEPT. QR2-001 is closed: a freshly drained Running pair invokes ReconcileAsync directly as the sole serializable terminal transaction, atomically committing Pass1Outcome, warnings, deterministic same-Repository REFERENCES Edges, child states, coordination, and the ReadyForResolution or FailedPass1 handoff without residual Reconciling. QR2-002 is closed: provider-transient claims are atomically relinquished without consuming retry or failure budget, active or future-eligible work is nonterminal, eligibility waits are activation/TimeProvider-backed, and shutdown drains local Workers before releasing pair-owned Profiled Revision bindings. The candidate preserves deterministic identity and ordering, exact authorization/revision/hash boundaries, bounded eight-operation navigate_code, immutable code-logic/file-v2 Documents with server-derived projections, partial-completion policy, Story 12.4/12.5 and CodeGraphContext exclusions, and the approved Windows-host/PostgreSQL-only architecture. Independent review reran 70 correction-focused tests with 70 passing and 251 broader navigation/document/failure/reconciliation tests with 250 passing; the sole initial real JDT-LS implementations timeout passed on an isolated 1/1 rerun and did not establish a reproducible code defect. The unavailable authenticated real approved-pair E2E and documented repository/environment full-suite baseline remain truthful limitations, not acceptance claims.
